boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Mississippi
boards.description: Current, under-21-safe food stops in Oxford with publicly listed late hours.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: 303 S Lamar Blvd, Oxford
cards.notes: Check the store page before leaving, then use pickup or delivery for warm cookies; the location lists service until 3 AM daily.
cards.short_summary: A dessert-focused option with the latest listed hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies’ Oxford store page states that warm cookies are delivered until 3 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Official store page lists warm-cookie delivery until 3 AM daily; confirm pickup availability when ordering.

cards.title: Taco Bell on University Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1726 University Ave, Oxford
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru or place a pickup order; official hours list 3 AM most nights and 4 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A University Avenue drive-thru with especially late listed closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s Oxford location lists drive-thru hours until 3 AM Sunday–Thursday and 4 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed drive-thru hours run to 3 AM Sunday–Thursday and 4 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Domino’s on University Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1920 University Ave, Oxford
cards.notes: Order carryout or delivery through the location page and check the day’s hours; this store is currently listed open until 2 AM.
cards.short_summary: A late-listed pizza carryout and delivery location on University Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page for 1920 University Ave in Oxford lists the store open until 2 AM.
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently lists this store open until 2 AM; hours vary by location and date.

cards.title: Domino’s on West Jackson Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1603 Jackson Ave W, Oxford
cards.notes: Choose delivery or carryout from the West Jackson location and review the live store listing; it is currently shown open until 2 AM.
cards.short_summary: A separate Domino’s location with a current 2 AM listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official Oxford page identifies the 1603 Jackson Ave W location as open until 2 AM.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza — 1603 Jackson Ave W, Oxford
cards.access_notes: The official Domino’s listing currently shows this Oxford location open until 2 AM; recheck before travel.

cards.title: Papa Johns on West Jackson Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1506 Jackson Ave W, Oxford
cards.notes: Schedule delivery or carryout from the official ordering page; listed hours run to midnight daily and 1:30 AM Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: Pizza delivery and carryout with extended weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists delivery and carryout until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 AM Friday–Saturday at this Oxford store.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns Pizza — 1506 Jackson Ave W, Oxford
cards.access_notes: Official delivery and carryout listings run until 12 AM Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: HWY 6 W Krystal
cards.subtitle: 420 Hwy 6 W, Oxford
cards.notes: Use pickup or delivery and confirm the day’s schedule; official hours extend to 11:30 PM Thursday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Highway 6 fast-food stop with later hours later in the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Krystal’s official Oxford page lists hours until 11:30 PM Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list 11:30 PM closing Thursday–Saturday, with earlier closing times on other days.

cards.title: Jimmy John’s on West Jackson Avenue
cards.subtitle: 2206 Jackson Ave W, Oxford
cards.notes: Place a delivery order from the location page; official delivery hours run until 1 AM every day, while the store closes earlier.
cards.short_summary: A sandwich delivery option with a separate late delivery schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John’s lists delivery hours from 10:30 AM to 1 AM daily for its 2206 Jackson Ave W Oxford store.
cards.access_notes: Official delivery hours are 10:30 AM–1 AM daily; in-store hours end at 10 PM.

cards.title: Donut Distillery Oxford
cards.subtitle: 1107 East Jackson Ave, Oxford
cards.notes: Order pickup from the donut shop and verify the date; listed shop hours reach midnight Monday–Wednesday and 2 AM Thursday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A made-to-order donut shop with late-weekend service.
cards.evidence_claim: Donut Distillery’s Oxford page lists donut-shop hours until midnight Monday–Wednesday and 2 AM Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: For the donut shop, official listed hours are to 12 AM Monday–Wednesday and 2 AM Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: DQ Grill & Chill on Jackson Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1700 Jackson Ave W, Oxford
cards.notes: Check the location page and order a food or treat item before its listed 10:30 PM close; delivery is listed to the same time.
cards.short_summary: A late-evening food-and-treat stop on West Jackson Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Dairy Queen lists store and delivery hours until 10:30 PM daily for 1700 Jackson Avenue West in Oxford.
cards.source_title: DQ Grill & Chill — 1700 Jackson Avenue West, Oxford
cards.access_notes: Official store and delivery hours are listed as 10:30 AM–10:30 PM daily.

cards.title: Chick-fil-A West Jackson Avenue
cards.subtitle: 2307 Jackson Ave W, Oxford
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru before its listed 10 PM close Monday through Saturday; note that this location is closed on Sundays.
cards.short_summary: A West Jackson Avenue drive-thru with a clearly listed 10 PM close.
cards.evidence_claim: Chick-fil-A lists drive-thru hours of 6 AM–10 PM Monday–Saturday and closure on Sunday for this Oxford restaurant.
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours are 6 AM–10 PM Monday–Saturday; the restaurant is closed Sunday.
